patch_description: Preserve the current policy’s bounded relocation, partial particle retention, and protection of improving or dispersed swarms. Cross in the inspiration’s velocity reset and displacement cue only when deterioration is severe, the swarm is compact, and recent improvement is negligible. The hypothesis is that selective stronger recovery can release stalled swarms while preserving useful search structure elsewhere. Memories remain reevaluated because the supplied feedback shows little evaluation cost from refreshing them. This proposal is untested; improved performance requires evaluation.
